grouping: Disjoint preassigned sampling strata, 50 original cases each; original overlapping HOL labels retained in selected_pairs.jsonl.
intervals: Wilson 95% binomial intervals; conditional denominators reported. All unconditional rates use all assigned cases. Missing answers score zero for accuracy and decisive-change success; missing original/control answers count as failures in the control flip-or-missing rate (legacy key false_flip_rate). Missing decisive answers do not exclude observed control pairs.
